actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: Every condition is registered as humanoidtoolbench/{scenario}-L{level}-{mode} for the three scenarios, three levels and two modes, with entry point humanoidtoolbench.envs.sonic_loco_manip:SonicLocoManipEnv
Every cell is registered with max_episode_steps=3000, one minute at the 50 Hz control rate
Environment IDs have the form humanoidtoolbench/G1<Scenario>-L<level>-<mode>; the default condition is G1BallMove-L0-S
Every condition uses 3000 policy-control steps per episode at 50 Hz
SonicLocoManipEnv.reset takes seed and options and returns (observation, info); step takes one action and returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
A control step applies the action and advances the simulator control_decimal times, where control_decimal = (1/physics_dt)/render_hz
The task metadata declares physics_dt 0.005 s, control_hz 200 and render_hz 50
The G1 whole-body robot has wholebody_dof 43
The whole-body joint list is 6 left leg, 6 right leg, 3 waist, 7 left arm, 7 right arm, 7 left hand and 7 right hand joints
The action space is a Dict of seven Box spaces named left_leg, right_leg, waist, left_arm, right_arm, left_eef and right_eef
The leg, waist and arm joint-position controllers bound every joint to -1 to 1
The dexterous-hand controllers bound every hand joint to -pi to pi
The observation space starts with joint_qpos, a Box from -pi to pi with shape wholebody_dof
The observation space also declares a head stereo pair and left and right wrist camera spaces
A camera observation space is a Box from 0 to 255 with shape (height, width, 3)
Every camera stream is 640 by 360 pixels
The environment returns joint_qpos as a float32 array from the MuJoCo simulator, and render_obs decides whether camera frames are added
The environment terminates on task success or failure and its step returns truncated False
The reward is the task's compute_reward result; ToolReasoningTask returns the lifted height fraction
Task.reset(seed) seeds the layout randomizers: DRManager.reset sets Python's random and numpy seeds when a seed is given
SonicLocoManipEnv.__init__ requires a sonic_config mapping
The evaluation CLI creates the environment with gym.make and passes split, sim_mode, physics_dt, headless and sonic_config
The project requires Python 3.10.* and depends on mujoco 3.11.0, gymnasium > 0.29.1, numpy 1.26.4, torch 2.7.0 and gear_sonic
The README requires Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU and EGL headless rendering
The docs describe a (T, 36) policy action chunk of 50 Hz controller commands, separate from the environment action vector
The docs state joint angles and angular commands use radians, base height metres and navigation velocities metres per second
The docs state the raw robot observation has 43 joint values and the policy state excludes the leg joints

determinism.notes: the upstream Task.reset(seed) seeds the layout randomizers (dr/manager.py:29-36), so one seed and one action sequence repeat the upstream layout; this package's fake does not draw a layout and its 43-joint state is deterministic, so the fake repeats for every seed.  The sim backend was not run.

gaps: F0 is the claim of the fake backend: it is kinematic and sets each of the 43 joint positions to the commanded value; it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator forces, sensors or noise.  The upstream simulation is MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics with contacts, but it was not run here.

the fake omits the camera streams: the real observation adds head_stereo_left, head_stereo_right, wrist_left and wrist_right, each 640 by 360 by 3 uint8 (tasks/g1_toolbench_tabletop.py:38-41,86-120), and the real observation space declares them; the fake returns only the 43-value joint_qpos

the fake does not model the task layout, object poses, tool selection, contact metrics, success or failure predicates or the reward: reset starts every joint at zero (the controller init_qpos), step returns reward 0.0 and never terminates on success; only the registered 3000-step truncation is applied

the fake applies the action once per 20 ms control step, while the upstream applies it over 4 physics steps of 5 ms (tasks/g1_toolbench_tabletop.py:70-73, envs/sonic_loco_manip.py:70,78); timestep_ms names the 5 ms physics step as FID-015 requires when the two are separated, and a cap.world.step.v1 tick is one 20 ms control step
no rendering: the fake render() returns no frames and cap.world.render.v1 stays unbound
the fake does not reproduce the upstream numpy random stream or the layout draw; a seed gives the same zero joint state in the fake and a different layout upstream

the sim backend was not run: it needs gymnasium, MuJoCo 3.11.0, torch 2.7.0, gear_sonic and decoupled-wbc (pyproject.toml:8-22), a GPU with EGL headless rendering (README.md:20-28), and a sonic_config from the evaluation CLI (cli/eval_decoupled_wbc.py:154-161) that the registration alone does not supply
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, so ticks advance simulated time only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses every step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last world state stays readable; the simulator has no native stop
